CREATE Procedure CDN.KOL_EksportJmL(@TS int,@Ope_Numer int) AS BEGIN TRAN
SELECT isnull(SLW_ID, 0) as [ID], isnull(SLW_WartoscS,'') as [Nazwa], isnull(SLW_WartoscN1,0) as [Dlugosc], isnull(SLW_WartoscN2,0) as [Szerokosc], isnull(SLW_WartoscN3,0) as [Wysokosc], isnull(SLW_WartoscN4,0) as [Waga], isnull(SLW_Aktywny,0) as [Aktywny] FROM CDN.Slowniki WHERE Slw_Kategoria = 'Jednostki składowania' UNION SELECT 0 as [ID] , '' as [NAZWA] , 0 as [Długość],0 as [Szerokość],0 as [Wysokość] ,0 as [Waga], 1 as [Aktywny] ORDER BY ID
COMMIT TRAN
